title.zh: Crypto Industry Points to SEC and CFTC After CLARITY Setback
title.en: Crypto Industry Points to SEC and CFTC After CLARITY Setback

current_state.zh: After the Senate blocked the CLARITY Act, crypto trade groups and executives are urging the SEC and CFTC to advance crypto regulation through agency rulemaking, noting that rules are less durable than legislation since future chairs can rewrite them.
current_state.en: After the Senate blocked the CLARITY Act, crypto trade groups and executives are urging the SEC and CFTC to advance crypto regulation through agency rulemaking, noting that rules are less durable than legislation since future chairs can rewrite them.
